summary: Sending a message takes one round trip fewer in stui and the phone, and a read receipt st refuses for good is no longer retried

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire change: a message send already needed only a snapshot of this host not ahead of its store; the clients now use the newest one a window brought, and read a fresh one only when st calls it stale.
